asked.item: Blotato automatically reposts failed Instagram posts forever
Which error the failed Instagram post had (not named by customer)

verdict.reason: The only automatic-retry sentence covers the "Error posting to Instagram: An internal server error occurred" error and says Blotato retries 2 times, so it neither confirms nor denies "forever," and the customer's own error is not named, so no sentence states the answer for this case.
